name: Steamtech Ultimate Dragon Weapon
text:
5 "Steamtech" Monsters
Must first be Fusion Summoned using Monsters you control. While this Fusion Summoned monster is face-up on your Field, "Steamtech" Monsters you control cannot be destroyed by card effect. Once per turn: you can banish 1 "Steamtech" Fusion Monster in your GY, destroy all monster card on your opponents field. Once per turn (Quick Effect): If this card is in the GY and a card effect would be activated that would target a "Steamtech" You control, you can banish this card, if you do negate the activation, then destroy that card.
